profile.Name: Mariah
profile.Personality: A devout follower of Okran who grieves for her daughter Knife. She loves Knife still but scorns the Flotsam Ninjas as heretics, insists on giving gifts, and curses anyone who sneers at them or at her faith.
profile.Backstory: She lives in Stack. Long ago Knife ran off with the Flotsam Ninjas, and Mariah fears she is dead, since a good lady of Okran would have come home. Knife has sent her gifts over the years, and Mariah would reward anyone who brings her daughter back.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rambles to herself in broken phrases and long pauses, mourning 'my sweet daughter, Knife'. Praises Okran and sneers at 'flotsam'.
